research_notes: Follow-up: establish pre-2006 jobs and complete study dates; seek Fifield and VECCI dated position records and IPA 2011/2016 appointment/departure records for hours, leave and role transitions. Date fellowships and patronage and determine whether paid, without assuming executive titles prove full-time work.

Reviewed 2026-09-29: APH, own biography, IPA annual report staff/institutional pages, public secondary promotion chronology. Targeted first-job and employer searches did not establish additional jobs or full-time terms; unrelated sports coaches and writers excluded.

The IPA report directly describes a nonprofit financed by voluntary contributions; its free-market advocacy is not a reason to code employment as private enterprise. Employer association and political-staff exclusions are also applied consistently.
No numerical years computed; unknown career coverage is not zero. Year-level boundary overlaps retained. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record remains unresolved.

2026-10-02 follow-up found contemporary US Congressional Record and programme brochure substantiating previously omitted2008 unpaid full-time internship. Added VECCI writer and Fifield special adviser titles from existing secondary biography and contemporary2013 IPA editor byline. Targeted IPA appointment/annual report and first-job/hour searches yielded no other qualifying paid work or complete chronology. Unrelated rugby player, UK economist and TV archivist excluded. Next: resolve2008 break in Fifield employment, VECCI appointment terms, IPA promotion/leave records and pre2006 jobs. Intern programme months are described in evidence, not invented personal endpoints. All added roles excluded; no zero headline inferred.

2026-10-03 follow-up adds three omitted official party/student-political offices: University of Melbourne Liberal Club vice-president2008, Australian Liberal Students' Federation vice-president2008–2009 and Victorian Young Liberals president2009. They are retained as overlapping party activity and excluded without assuming pay or workload. A contemporaneous ABC biography observes University of Melbourne student status and former Liberal-staffer status on15September2010, but does not establish study or Fifield exact boundaries. IPA primary material observes his writing byDecember2011, editorship byDecember2012, development/communications directorship in2014 and deputy title by2014–2016; it still does not resolve exact appointment/departure days, hours or leave. VECCI appointment terms and pre2006 jobs remain unresolved; no headline zero inferred.
